## ملخص سريع

**الهدف:** حلقة كاملة تعمل مباشرة على المسرح — صوت خليجي → نص → نية → رد — لـ 10 أوامر ثابتة.

**3 معالم رئيسية:**
| التاريخ | المعلم |
|---|---|
| **4 نوفمبر** | المحوّل النصّي يعمل للنوايا العشر (M1) |
| **10 نوفمبر** | 50 مقطع تعمل تلقائياً، دقة ≥ 85%، زمن رد < 4 ثوانٍ (M2) |
| **15 نوفمبر** | 🎤 العرض في Lab 3 — تجميد الكود من 12/11 |

**توصيتي لمحوّل النوايا (ما زال معلقاً من 20/10):** ابدأ بالخيار **A** (قواعد + مطابقة ضبابية) كخط أساس — 2–3 أيام ويعطي عرضاً موثوقاً — ثم طوّره إلى **B** (مصنِّف arabic-bert) إذا بقي وقت، أو **C** (نداء أدوات LLM) للإبهار لكن مع مخاطرة الإنترنت على المسرح. A يبقى作为احتياطي في كل الأحوال.

**أكبر خطر:** تأجيل قرار المحوّل → الأسبوع الثاني ينهار. لذلك الاجتماع مع د. نورة لازم يكون **قبل 2 نوفمبر**.

## المطلوب منك الآن (هذا الأسبوع)
1. تحدد الـ 10 نوايا للعرض (أقدر أساعدك تسرد 5 صياغات لكل واحدة من التسجيلات الموجودة).
2. تراسل د. نورة اليوم أو بكرة لتحديد الموعد.

تحب أساعدك الآن في سرد النوايا العشر وصياغاتها، ولا أجهّز لك مسودة إيميل لد. نورة؟

*(ملاحظة جانبية: midterm أمن المعلومات بعد 7 أيام — الخطة خصصت له ساعة يومياً 2–4 نوفمبر بدون برمجة.)*

# Saut — Project Plan

**Owner:** Sami · **Supervisor:** Dr. Noura · **Plan start:** 2026-10-29
**Hard deadlines:** prototype demo **2026-11-15 23:59 (Lab 3)** · final report **2026-12-10 (online)**

**Current state:** ✅ 50 Gulf-Arabic test commands recorded · ✅ Whisper speech-to-text working · ❌ intent parser missing.

---

## 1. Scope of the demo (MVP)

A live end-to-end loop: **Arabic speech → text → intent → action → spoken/text reply**, for a fixed set of ~10 demo commands.

Out of scope for the demo (stretch goals for the final report): multi-turn dialogue, user memory, mobile app.

## 2. Technical workstreams

| # | Workstream | Status | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| W1 | Audio capture + Whisper STT | ✅ done | Keep the 50 clips as the fixed eval set |
| W2 | **Intent parser** | ❌ open | Decision needed (see §3) |
| W3 | Action/skill layer | ❌ not started | 10 intents → handlers (time, prayer, notes, weather, navigation… choose what demos well) |
| W4 | Response generation (Arabic TTS or text) | ❌ not started | Reuse existing TTS if available; text fallback on stage |
| W5 | Demo UI (single web page or terminal) | ❌ not started | Simple mic button + transcript + reply |
| W6 | Evaluation harness | ⚠️ partial | Script that runs all 50 clips → WER + intent accuracy; run after every change |
| W7 | Documentation (report chapters 1–3 + demo slides) | ❌ not started | Start early; report is due 12-10 |

## 3. Decision to lock first: intent parser

Options discussed 2026-10-20, still open. Recommendation: **A as baseline, B if time allows.**

| Option | Effort | Pros | Risks |
|---|---|---|---|
| **A. Rule/keyword + fuzzy matching** on the Whisper text | 2–3 days | Fast, deterministic, demos reliably, no training data needed | Brittle on unseen phrasing |
| **B. Fine-tuned Arabic intent classifier** (e.g. arabic-bert / fastText) | 5–7 days | Generalises better, stronger for the report | Needs labelled data from the 50 clips + augmentation |
| **C. LLM function-calling** | 2–3 days | Handles paraphrasing, impressive live | Internet/latency risk on demo day, cost |

→ **Action: book Dr. Noura before 2026-11-02 to approve the option + the 10-intent list.**

## 4. Timeline

### Week 1 — Oct 29 → Nov 4 · *lock decision, build baseline*
- [ ] Oct 29–30: list the 10 demo intents + 5 phrasings each (from existing recordings)
- [ ] Oct 30: email Dr. Noura → meeting before Nov 2 (parser choice + intent list approval)
- [ ] Oct 31 → Nov 3: implement parser **Option A** baseline + wiring into the pipeline
- [ ] Nov 2–4: IS midterm revision (exam **Nov 5**) — ~1h/day
- **Milestone M1 (Nov 4):** text → intent works on typed input for all 10 intents

### Week 2 — Nov 5 → Nov 11 · *end-to-end + integration*
- [ ] Nov 5: exam day, light work only
- [ ] Nov 6–8: full speech→reply loop, action handlers, demo UI
- [ ] Nov 9–10: eval run on 50 clips; fix the top failure cases
- [ ] Nov 11: buffer / catch-up
- **Milestone M2 (Nov 10):** 50-clip pipeline runs unattended; **≥85% intent accuracy**, end-to-end reply < 4 s
- [ ] Nov 9: start slides + a 5-minute demo script

### Week 3 — Nov 12 → Nov 15 · *freeze and rehearse*
- [ ] Nov 12: **code freeze** — bug fixes only, no new features
- [ ] Nov 13: full rehearsal on Lab 3 machines (mic! audio! network!)
- [ ] Nov 14: slides, screenshots + a **pre-recorded backup video** of the working demo
- [ ] Nov 15: 🎤 **Demo, 23:59, Lab 3**

### Phase 2 — Nov 16 → Dec 10 · *final report*
- [ ] Nov 16–18: debrief, list reviewer feedback, upgrade parser to Option B if promised
- [ ] Nov 19 → Dec 1: write report chapters (intro, lit review, method, results from the eval harness)
- [ ] Nov 20: AI final · Dec 3: Cloud final — protect study days
- [ ] Dec 4–9: supervisor review round + editing
- [ ] Dec 10: 📄 submit final report (online)

## 5. Risks

| Risk | Likelihood | Mitigation |
|---|---|---|
| Gulf-dialect WER breaks intent accuracy | Medium | Fuzzy matching + phonetic normalisation; keep eval set local |
| Parser choice delayed → week 2 slips | High | Meeting before Nov 2; start Option A regardless (it's reusable as fallback) |
| Demo-day mic/network failure | Medium | Rehearse in Lab 3 + backup video + text-only mode |
| Midterm/finals collide with coding | High | Fixed 1h/day study blocks; no coding on exam days |

## 6. Definition of done (demo)

1. Live loop works for 10/10 scripted commands, twice in a row without a restart.
2. Intent accuracy ≥ 85% on the 50-clip set, number reproducible by the eval script.
3. Latency speech → reply under ~4 s.
4. Backup video + slides ready before Nov 15.
